text:
Alice: Heads-up — we're scheduling a rolling maintenance for the runtime kernels tomorrow (Nov 20) 02:00–03:30 UTC. Goal: kernel perf fix + improved batch kernel selection. Need statuspage update + customer email. We'll pin Dedicated pools to previous runtime during canary/rollout by default. Thoughts? :eyes:

Bob: Confirming time is OK for ops. Which regions should we call out? APAC, EMEA, NA?

Diana: APAC morning traffic is low at that hour, but include local times in the email. Also note that Private/VPC customers may need to accept new images — we should call that out separately.

Carlos: Draft status page snippet below:

```
Scheduled maintenance: Runtime kernel update
Start: 2025-11-20 02:00 UTC
End: 2025-11-20 03:30 UTC
Components affected: Hosted API (brief), Dedicated pools (rolling), Private deployments (no automatic changes)
Impact: Customers may experience transient latency spikes or brief 5xx errors during canary/rollout. We will automatically roll back if error rates exceed 5% for >5m.
Notes: Canary will run in one pool for 15m before global rollout. No data loss expected. Support: support@redwood.ai
```

Emily: Add line: "We will pin affected Dedicated customers to the previous runtime automatically if we trigger rollback." Also include contact link and how to opt-out of auto-pin.

Bob: Subject line suggestion: "Scheduled maintenance — Redwood runtime upgrade (Nov 20 UTC)". Alternate: "Important: Short maintenance window — possible brief latency"

Diana: For APAC copy, include local time: "Nov 20 11:00 PDT / Nov 20 02:00 UTC / Nov 20 12:00 JST" — can we auto-generate times in the email template?

Carlos: Customer email draft (HTML/plain):

```
Subject: Scheduled maintenance — Redwood runtime upgrade (Nov 20)
Hi <Customer>,

We will perform a short maintenance window to deploy a runtime kernel update on Nov 20, 02:00–03:30 UTC. During this window you may see brief latency spikes or transient errors. We will run a 15-minute canary and will automatically roll back and pin Dedicated pools if the canary detects regressions.

If you are on a Private deployment, no automatic changes will be applied. Please coordinate with your infra contact if you want us to apply the update.

Questions? Reply to this email or open a ticket at https://support.redwood.ai

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Operations
```

Alice: Looks good. Can we also prepare a 24h reminder and 1h reminder templates? And a short statuspage-only blurb for customers who prefer short updates.

Carlos: Added 24h/1h hooks in the draft and a short status blurb:

```
Short blurb: Planned maintenance: brief performance upgrade. Start Nov 20 02:00 UTC. Some customers may see brief latency/5xx. We'll post updates here.
```

deploy-bot: deploy-schedule created: maintenance:kernel-update -> scheduled 2025-11-20T02:00:00Z

statusbot: Status page draft saved to https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/zzz-temp

Emily: Ops oncall ok'd the rollback thresholds. Security reviewed and gave a thumbs up for no secret material changes. :thumbsup:

Diana: Suggest adding rollback runbook link in email: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/rollback-runtime

Alice: Approved. Send the 24h reminder tomorrow at 02:00 UTC-24h. Support team, please queue the statuspage post and cadence (in-progress -> monitoring -> resolved). I'll pin the rollout plan in #eng-releases. Thanks all. :pray:
